title: Encoded evaluator step
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $R$ and $w$ be finite bit strings, let $P$ be a finite list of bit strings, and let $vs$ be a finite list of natural numbers. Encode the context consisting of $n$, $R$, and $P$, together with $w$ and $vs$. One encoded evaluator step on this state equals the encoding of the state obtained by one abstract evaluator step on $(w,vs)$, using modulus equal to the binary value of $R$ plus one and assigning input index $i$ the binary value of the $i$th entry of $P$ plus one (with a missing entry treated as the empty bit string).
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a finite list of bit strings
$vs$ is a finite list of natural numbers
